About Me

FULL-STACK DIGITAL MARKETER

Hi, I’m Makarand Dawane, a Full-Stack Digital Marketer with over 4 years of professional experience. My core expertise is in SEO, Performance Marketing, AI-driven Web Design, and Multimedia. I’m also currently expanding my skills in Marketing Automation.

Throughout my career, I have worked with fast-growing brands, enterprise research firms, and EdTech AI platforms, helping them improve their digital presence and overall business growth. Through my work, I have contributed to increasing organic traffic by up to 165%, generating more than 4,500 qualified leads, and achieving up to 4.5:1 ROAS through performance marketing campaigns.

My key skills include Technical SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, WordPress and CMS-based Web Design, AI-powered Creative Design, and conversion-focused Landing Page Development.

I believe in combining data-driven marketing strategies with creativity, modern design, and AI technology. My goal is not just to generate traffic or leads, but to create measurable results, scalable business growth, and long-term digital impact.
